## VIC block-tridiagonal assembly: the Roe-linearised flux divergence along a column (`vic_assemble_full_impl`) {#sec-ch07-vic-assembly}

### Summary

The VIC replaces the explicit $x_1$ flux divergence by an implicit one. It does not re-solve the Riemann
problem. It linearises a Roe flux about the current state, holding the dissipation matrices $\mathsf A^{\pm}$[^rg-01671098d49b] fixed, so the
correction is one linear block-tridiagonal solve per column.

**Answered at @sec-ch06-vic:** the gravity rows of the operator ($\Phi$[^rg-45cfed262bb0] and the face work).

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Builds the blocks $\mathsf A_i$[^rg-7cbe60c8e9d5], $\mathsf B_i$, $\mathsf C_i$ of each column's implicit system; @eq-ch07-vic-blocks.

**Data.** Reads the stage primitives, face areas, volumes, $\Delta t_c$[^rg-563491e91074], the solid mask and, for $N=3$, the explicit increment; writes $N\times N$ blocks per cell and, for $N=3$, the right-hand-side term $\mathbf f^{\mathrm{tan}}_i$.

**Placement.** Every stage with a VIC, after the explicit increment and before the sweep.

**Activation.** `integration/implicit-scheme` 1 ($3\times3$) or 9 ($5\times5$).

**Guarantee / limits.** A linearisation about the stage state with $\mathsf A^{\pm}$ frozen; `vic-partial` does not solve for $m_2$, $m_3$ but ties their increments to the mass increment, @eq-ch07-vic-fold.

**Evidence.** @tbl-ch07-vic-assembly-tests; `test_backward_substitution.release`, `test_vic_partial_tangential.release`, `vic_assembly_check.py` `[C1]`–`[C7]`.
:::

Local symbols: $\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv},i}$ is the solved state of cell $i$[^rg-7f2b700e0b40]; $\mathbf F(\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv}})$ the Euler $x_1$
flux function of the solved variables and $\hat{\mathbf F}_{i\pm1/2}$ its linearised Roe form at a face (not the
numerical flux $\mathbf F_1$ of @sec-ch04); $\mathsf J_i=\partial\mathbf F/\partial\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv}}$ at cell $i$;
$A_{i\pm1/2}$[^rg-a84b95ff1250] [m$^2$] the $x_1$ face areas and $V_i$[^rg-eeb1953951ea] [m$^3$] the cell volume; $\Delta t_c$ [s] the step handed to the solve
(@sec-ch07-vic-stage); $\zeta_n=n(\epsilon_{\mathrm m}/2)/(1-n\epsilon_{\mathrm m}/2)$ bounds the relative error of $n$
roundings. The solved variables are $(\rho, \rho v_1, E)$ ($N=3$) or $(\rho, \rho v_1, \rho v_2, \rho v_3, E)$ ($N=5$),
in [kg m$^{-3}$], [kg m$^{-2}$ s$^{-1}$] and [J m$^{-3}$], total-mass basis; an entry of a block is in [unit of its
row's variable]/([unit of its column's variable] s), so s$^{-1}$ on its diagonal. For the partial system,
$a\in\{2,3\}$ names a tangential direction; $\tilde m_{a,i}$ [kg m$^{-2}$ s$^{-1}$] is the part of the explicit
tangential-momentum increment of cell $i$ that its explicit mass increment does not carry; $\mathsf A_i[m_a]$,
$\mathsf B_i[m_a]$, $\mathsf C_i[m_a]$ are the $m_a$ columns of the full blocks, restricted to the rows
$(\rho,\rho v_1,E)$; and $\mathbf f^{\mathrm{tan}}_i$ is the right-hand-side term they make (@eq-ch07-vic-fold).

### Derivation

Let $\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv}} = (\rho, \rho v_1, [\rho v_2, \rho v_3,] E)$ be the solved variables of a cell, with the total
density $\rho$ first (total-mass basis; the conserved $\mathbf U$ starts with the dry density instead). The Roe flux
at face $i+\tfrac12$ is
$\hat{\mathbf F}_{i+1/2} = \tfrac12\big(\mathbf F(\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv},i}) + \mathbf F(\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv},i+1})\big) - \tfrac12\mathsf A^+(\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv},i+1}-\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv},i})$,
and at $i-\tfrac12$ the same with $\mathsf A^-$, where $\mathsf A^{\pm} = \mathsf R\lvert\Lambda\rvert\mathsf R^{-1}$ at the Roe
average of the two cells. The residual of row $i$ is
$\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv},i}/\Delta t_c + (A_{i+1/2}\hat{\mathbf F}_{i+1/2} - A_{i-1/2}\hat{\mathbf F}_{i-1/2})/V_i - \Phi\,\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv},i}$,
with $\Phi$ the gravity Jacobian of @sec-ch06. Differentiating it with $\mathsf A^{\pm}$ frozen:

1. $\partial\hat{\mathbf F}_{i+1/2}/\partial\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv},i}=\tfrac12(\mathsf J_i+\mathsf A^+)$ and
   $\partial\hat{\mathbf F}_{i-1/2}/\partial\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv},i}=\tfrac12(\mathsf J_i-\mathsf A^-)$.
2. $\partial\hat{\mathbf F}_{i-1/2}/\partial\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv},i-1}=\tfrac12(\mathsf J_{i-1}+\mathsf A^-)$ and
   $\partial\hat{\mathbf F}_{i+1/2}/\partial\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv},i+1}=\tfrac12(\mathsf J_{i+1}-\mathsf A^+)$.
3. Multiplying by $\pm A_{i\pm1/2}/V_i$, adding $\mathsf I/\Delta t_c$ on the diagonal and subtracting $\Phi$ gives the
   blocks of row $i$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mathsf A_i &= \frac{1}{2V_i}\Big(A_{i-1/2}\mathsf A^- + A_{i+1/2}\mathsf A^+ + (A_{i+1/2}-A_{i-1/2})\mathsf J_i\Big) - \Phi + \frac{\mathsf I}{\Delta t_c}, \\
\mathsf B_i &= -\frac{A_{i-1/2}}{2V_i}\big(\mathsf A^- + \mathsf J_{i-1}\big), \\
\mathsf C_i &= -\frac{A_{i+1/2}}{2V_i}\big(\mathsf A^+ - \mathsf J_{i+1}\big).
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-ch07-vic-blocks}

@eq-ch07-vic-blocks is assembled by {{< code src/implicit/vic_assemble_full_impl.h vic_assemble_full_impl >}}.
The diagonal carries $\Delta t_c$, not $\Delta t$: the kernel sets `Dt.setConstant(1. / dt)` and adds it to the diagonal,
and the `dt`[^rg-9ef503f0dc9c] it receives is `dt_corr` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}). Steps 1 to 3 are checked
symbolically on generic $2\times2$ blocks; since the Euler flux is homogeneous of degree one,
$\mathbf F(\mathbf U)=\mathsf J(\mathbf U)\,\mathbf U$, the check writes the flux of each cell that way (`[C6]`). With face
work on, @sec-ch06 adds its rows to the energy row of the three blocks.

4. *The ported kernels.* Built from the ported kernels on a spherical shell, the blocks agree with central
   differences of the frozen-$\mathsf A^{\pm}$ residual to $8\times10^{-9}$ of the block size, the truncation of the
   difference quotient (`[C3]`).
5. *Why the frozen matrices are the right ones.* The coded left eigenvectors invert the right ones (`[C1]`), and
   $\mathsf R\Lambda\mathsf R^{-1}$ with signed eigenvalues is the flux Jacobian at the Roe state, with the Roe property
   $\mathsf R\Lambda\mathsf R^{-1}(\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv}}^{\mathrm R}-\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv}}^{\mathrm L}) = \mathbf F^{\mathrm R} - \mathbf F^{\mathrm L}$ for
   one $\gamma$[^rg-d3686c3b0d32] (`[C2]`).
6. *The partial system.* The $3\times3$ system keeps the rows and columns $(\rho,\rho v_1,E)$ of the full blocks; the
   tangential momenta $m_a=\rho v_a$ are not unknowns. Their increments are tied to the mass increment of the same
   cell, $\delta m_{a,i}=v_{a,i}\,\delta\rho_i+\tilde m_{a,i}$ with
   $\tilde m_{a,i}=\Delta^{\mathrm{stg}}m_{a,i}-v_{a,i}\,\Delta^{\mathrm{stg}}\rho_i$ from the explicit increment.
   Substituting this into the $(\rho,\rho v_1,E)$ rows of the full system gives the partial blocks and a
   right-hand-side term:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mathsf A^{\mathrm f}_i\mathbf e_\rho &= \mathsf A^{(3)}_i\mathbf e_\rho + \sum_{a=2,3} v_{a,i}\,\mathsf A_i[m_a], \\
\mathsf B^{\mathrm f}_i\mathbf e_\rho &= \mathsf B^{(3)}_i\mathbf e_\rho + \sum_{a=2,3} v_{a,i-1}\,\mathsf B_i[m_a], \\
\mathsf C^{\mathrm f}_i\mathbf e_\rho &= \mathsf C^{(3)}_i\mathbf e_\rho + \sum_{a=2,3} v_{a,i+1}\,\mathsf C_i[m_a], \\
\mathbf f^{\mathrm{tan}}_i &= \sum_{a=2,3}\big(\mathsf A_i[m_a]\,\tilde m_{a,i}+\mathsf B_i[m_a]\,\tilde m_{a,i-1}+\mathsf C_i[m_a]\,\tilde m_{a,i+1}\big),
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-ch07-vic-fold}

   where $\mathsf A^{(3)}_i$, $\mathsf B^{(3)}_i$, $\mathsf C^{(3)}_i$ are the $(\rho,\rho v_1,E)$ blocks of
   @eq-ch07-vic-blocks, $\mathbf e_\rho$ selects the density column (the other two columns are unchanged), the
   folded blocks $\mathsf A^{\mathrm f}_i$, $\mathsf B^{\mathrm f}_i$, $\mathsf C^{\mathrm f}_i$ are the ones solved, and the sweep solves with $\mathbf f_i-\mathbf f^{\mathrm{tan}}_i$ (@sec-ch07-vic-sweep). $\Phi$ and $\mathsf I/\Delta t_c$
   have no $m_a$ columns, so the $m_a$ columns are those of the flux terms and of the face work. At a closed end the
   wall mirror keeps $m_a$, so a face merged into $\mathsf A_i$ takes cell $i$'s $v_a$ and $\tilde m_{a}$.
   With $v_a=0$ and $\tilde m_a=0$ this is the full system restricted to $(\rho,\rho v_1,E)$, as is the frozen-$m_a$
   assembly the kernel builds without the explicit increment (`[C4]`: $3.3\times10^{-16}$ at rest, $3.7\times10^{-3}$
   at 50 m/s for the frozen form). Under a uniform tangential wind with $\tilde m_a=0$ the full solve keeps
   $\delta m_a=v_a\,\delta\rho$ to $1.5\times10^{-14}$ and $1.9\times10^{-15}$, and the folded partial solve equals it on $(\rho,\rho v_1,E)$ to
   $7.9\times10^{-15}$ at $v=(50,0)$ m/s and $4.2\times10^{-15}$ at $(400,-30)$ m/s, where the frozen-$m_a$ solve is off by
   $6.7\times10^{-2}$ and $2.1$ (`[C7]`).
7. *Round-off.* An entry of $\mathsf A_i$ is three products summed with two additions, one subtraction of areas,
   the factor `half_inv_vol` (itself one division), $-\Phi$ and $+1/\Delta t_c$ (one division, one addition): seven
   roundings on the longest path (a conservative count including the area subtraction). The $\zeta_8$ bound below remains valid. With $\mathsf A^{\pm}$ and $\mathsf J$ as computed, the entry is within $\zeta_8\approx4\epsilon_{\mathrm m}$
   of the sum of the magnitudes of its terms; $\mathsf B_i$ and $\mathsf C_i$ take four roundings, $\zeta_4$.

In the code, @eq-ch07-vic-blocks is the block set-up with `half_inv_vol` $=1/(2V_i)$, `area_i` $=A_{i-1/2}$ and
`area_ip1` $=A_{i+1/2}$ ({{< code src/implicit/vic_assemble_full_impl.h vic_assemble_full_impl >}}).

### Numerical method

See @fig-ch07-vic-stencil for the block row.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch07-vic-stencil
#| fig-cap: "The block row of cell $i$. The Roe dissipation matrices $\\mathsf A^{\\pm}$ sit on the two faces (orange) with the face areas $A_{i-1/2}$, $A_{i+1/2}$; the flux Jacobians $\\mathsf J$ sit in the three cells (blue). The blocks $\\mathsf A_i$, $\\mathsf B_i$, $\\mathsf C_i$ combine them as in @eq-ch07-vic-blocks, with $-\\Phi$ and $\\mathsf I/\\Delta t_c$ on the diagonal; the content of $\\Phi$ belongs to the gravity chapter."
#| fig-alt: "Three cells in a row with orange faces between them, labelled with the Roe matrices and face areas, and the formulas for the three blocks underneath."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch07.figures.fig_vic_stencil import make_fig
make_fig()
```

Each face takes its two neighbours' primitives. `RoeAverage` weights by $\sqrt\rho$ and averages the total
enthalpy ({{< code src/implicit/flux_decomposition_impl.h RoeAverage >}}); the caller passes the mean $\gamma$ of the two cells.
`Eigenvalue` returns $|v_1-c_s|$, $|v_1|$, $|v_1+c_s|$, $|v_1|$, $|v_1|$ ({{< code src/implicit/flux_decomposition_impl.h Eigenvalue >}}).
`Eigenvector` writes out the eigenvectors and their inverse by hand
({{< code src/implicit/flux_decomposition_impl.h Eigenvector >}}), and `FluxJacobian` the Euler flux Jacobian in conserved
variables ({{< code src/implicit/flux_decomposition_impl.h FluxJacobian >}}). The full kernel forms $\mathsf A^{\pm}$ as `Am` and `Ap`
at the lower and upper face ({{< code src/implicit/vic_assemble_full_impl.h vic_assemble_full_impl >}}) and then the blocks. The partial kernel copies
the $(\rho, \rho v_1, E)$ rows and columns out of the same $5\times5$ matrices into `Am2` and `Ap2`
({{< code src/implicit/vic_assemble_partial_impl.h vic_assemble_partial_impl >}}). With the explicit increment `du` and the
output `rhs_corr` set, it also copies the $m_a$ columns of the same matrices into `AmT`, `ApT`, `dfp_T`, `dfc_T`,
`dfn_T`, forms `aT`, `bT`, `cT` from them with the same terms as `a[i]`, `b[i]`, `c[i]` (and the face work), and
`fold_cell` adds $v_a$ times them to the density column of each block and $\tilde m_a$ times them to `rhs_corr`
(@eq-ch07-vic-fold). An exact zero $v_a$ or $\tilde m_a$ is skipped, so a wind-free column gets the same blocks and a
zero `rhs_corr`, bit for bit. A face to a solid neighbour is merged into `a[i]` like a wall face and takes cell $i$'s $v_a$ and $\tilde m_a$.
`vic_assemble_partial_cpu` passes the explicit increment and stores `rhs_corr` in `delta`, which the sweep reads
before it overwrites it ({{< code src/implicit/implicit_dispatch.cpp vic_assemble_partial_cpu >}}); a solid cell gets a
zero there.

On the CPU the assembly runs the columns in parallel and fills each cell independently. A solid cell gets
$\mathsf A_i=\mathsf I/\Delta t_c$, $\mathsf B_i=\mathsf C_i=0$, and its fluid neighbour sees a mirror of itself instead of the solid's state; both are
in `vic_assemble_full_cpu` ({{< code src/implicit/implicit_dispatch.cpp vic_assemble_full_cpu >}}), as the check confirms (`[C5]`). Before the assembly, the host
removes the EOS[^rg-466966ad271b] reference energy from the energy tendency and takes $\gamma$ from the EOS, through
`internal_energy_offset` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::_apply_implicit_correction >}}). It also rotates the velocity into the local orthonormal frame, through
`prim2local1_` ({{< code src/implicit/implicit_hydro.cpp ImplicitHydroImpl::forward_masked >}}).

### Code

The host entry point that applies the vertically implicit correction is
{{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::_apply_implicit_correction >}}, declared in
{{< code src/hydro/hydro.hpp HydroImpl::_apply_implicit_correction >}}:

```cpp
torch::Tensor HydroImpl::_apply_implicit_correction(
    torch::Tensor& du, torch::Tensor const& w,
    double dt, Variables const& other);
```

`du` is the explicit conserved-state increment, corrected in place; `w` is the stage primitive state;
the `dt` argument supplies the correction interval in seconds (`dt_corr`, the step multiplied by a valid current `rk3` stage's
`wght2`, or the step itself otherwise); and `other` is the named tensor map (`Variables`). When `other`
contains `solid`, the method uses that mask and `fill_solid_hydro_w` to supply solid-cell primitives and
zero their increment. The EOS and implicit solver are owned by the hydro module, not additional arguments.
The return is the conserved-state correction tensor, or an undefined tensor when no implicit solver is
configured. The caller and stage weighting are in
{{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}} and @sec-ch07-vic-stage.

: Code map of the VIC assembly. {#tbl-ch07-vic-assembly-code}

**How to use it.** The assembly has no key of its own: it runs whenever `implicit-scheme` is 1 or 9, and the card,
its refusals and the gravity it needs are those of @sec-ch07-vic-options. @eq-ch07-vic-blocks is these lines
({{< code src/implicit/vic_assemble_full_impl.h vic_assemble_full_impl >}}):

```cpp
  a[i] = (Am * area_i + Ap * area_ip1 + (area_ip1 - area_i) * dfdq_curr) *
             half_inv_vol -
         Phi;
  a[i].diagonal() += Dt;
  b[i] = -(Am + dfdq_prev) * area_i * half_inv_vol;
  c[i] = -(Ap - dfdq_next) * area_ip1 * half_inv_vol;
```

`a`, `b`, `c` are $\mathsf A_i$, $\mathsf B_i$, $\mathsf C_i$; `Am`, `Ap` are $\mathsf A^-$, $\mathsf A^+$; `dfdq_prev`, `dfdq_curr`,
`dfdq_next` are $\mathsf J_{i-1}$, $\mathsf J_i$, $\mathsf J_{i+1}$; and `Dt` is the vector of $1/\Delta t_c$.

: Tests of the VIC assembly (@tbl-ch07-ctest-run for the run at the pin). {#tbl-ch07-vic-assembly-tests}

`test_backward_substitution.release` and `test_vic_partial_tangential.release` pass at the pin (@tbl-ch07-ctest-run), with
{{< code tests/test_backward_substitution.cpp vic_flux_decomposition.species_relabeling_preserves_mixture_density >}}
as the first one's assembly case and {{< code tests/test_vic_partial_tangential.cpp vic_partial_tangential.equals_the_reduced_full_matrix >}}
comparing the partial blocks with the full ones. No ctest compares the blocks with a difference quotient; that is the check's job.
`vic_assembly_check.py` ports the assembly kernels line for line, with zero gravity.[^ch07-vic-assembly-run]
`[C1]` inverts the eigenvectors within $10^{-14}$ over 200 Roe states; `[C2]` matches the Jacobian and the Roe
property within $10^{-12}$; `[C3]` matches the difference quotient within $10^{-6}$;
`[C4]` gives a relative difference of the frozen-$m_a$ solve below $10^{-12}$ at $v=0$ and above $10^{-6}$ at 50 m/s; `[C5]` keeps a solid
row exact; `[C6]` derives the three blocks exactly; `[C7]` ports @eq-ch07-vic-fold and the sweep's subtraction, and
asks for $10^{-10}$ between the folded and the full solve under a uniform wind and more than $10^{-3}$ for the
frozen one. `[C7]` fails when the density-column term of the fold is removed (folded $6.7\times10^{-2}$ and $2.1$).
The CUDA assembly shares the same headers and is not run here.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
The operator is a linearisation with $\mathsf A^{\pm}$ frozen. It is not the Jacobian of the explicit Riemann solver
the stage used, so the implicit and explicit fluxes are not the same function.
:::

1. **Mean $\gamma$.** The Roe average at a face uses the mean $\gamma$ of the two cells. The Roe property holds
   only when they are equal (`[C2]` tests one $\gamma$).
2. **Partial system.** `vic-partial` does not solve the $m_2$, $m_3$ rows: it assumes each cell's tangential
   momentum changes by $v_a$ times its mass change plus the explicit remainder (@eq-ch07-vic-fold). That is exact
   for a uniform tangential wind (`[C7]`). Where $v_a$ varies along the column, the full solve can move $m_a$ in a
   way the partial one cannot. The `[C7]` comparison is a port with zero gravity; no run quantifies the difference
   in a sheared column.
3. **No difference-quotient test of the blocks.** No ctest compares $\mathsf A_i$, $\mathsf B_i$, $\mathsf C_i$ with a
   difference quotient; `test_vic_partial_tangential` compares the partial blocks with the full ones. The column
   tests check rest states only.

<!-- reader glossary notes -->
[^rg-01671098d49b]: $\mathsf A^{\pm}$ — the Roe dissipation matrices $\mathsf R\lvert\Lambda\rvert\mathsf R^{-1}$ at faces $i\pm\tfrac12$

[^rg-45cfed262bb0]: $\Phi$ — the gravity source Jacobian; upright, not sans-serif like the other matrices, because the math font has no sans-serif Greek and `\mathsf` drops the glyph in the PDF

[^rg-7cbe60c8e9d5]: $\mathsf A_i, \mathsf B_i, \mathsf C_i$ — the diagonal, lower and upper blocks of row $i$ of the block-tridiagonal system

[^rg-563491e91074]: $\Delta t_c$ — the time step handed to the implicit solve: $w_{2,s}\Delta t$ under rk3 and rk3s4, $\Delta t$ under rk1 and rk2

[^rg-7f2b700e0b40]: $i, j, k$ — cell indices in $x_1, x_2, x_3$

[^rg-a84b95ff1250]: $A_{i\pm1/2}$ — $x_1$ face area

[^rg-eeb1953951ea]: $V_i$ — cell volume

[^rg-9ef503f0dc9c]: dt — time-step duration

[^rg-d3686c3b0d32]: $\gamma$ — mixture ratio of specific heats $c_p/c_v$, local, varies with composition, dimensionless [-]; $\gamma_{\mathrm{d}}$ is the dry value

[^rg-466966ad271b]: EOS — equation of state
<!-- end reader glossary notes -->
